rfc: RFC-0043 (input frozen by Amendment A2, list result by Amendment A1; both owner re-adjudication 2026-10-01)
adr: ADR-0019 (Rust-compiled package core production path, accepted 2026-09-30)

functions.name: detect-lines
functions.signature: detect-lines(bmp: Bytes, min-run: U64) -> Result[Bytes, Text]
functions.input-encoding: RFC-0043-A2 self-describing packed header; this op is grey8-only (a bgra8 input -> unsupported-format, per RFC-0043 §A4 grey8/threshold raster family)
functions.result-encoding: RFC-0043-A1 list<region>: count u32 LE, then count x 16 B (x,y,width,height u32 LE); empty result is a count=0 blob as ok
functions.semantics: maximal horizontal runs of foreground pixels (grey value >= 128) whose length >= min-run become region {x, y, len, 1}; row-major order (y outer, x inner); integer-only
functions.semantics-provenance: RFC-0043 §A4 delegates this op's exact behaviour to the determinism rules + the content-asserting corpus; the fixed thresholds (foreground>=128, horizontal maximal runs, count=0 empty=ok) are that frozen reference definition, documented here and in the guest crate, not a cross-boundary wire contract

refusal-corpus.source: independent oracle (pure stdlib Python run-detection re-implementation, no shared code with the Rust core; numpy absent offline)

not-applicable.region-out-of-bounds: inapplicable to detect-lines: every emitted region derives from a within-image horizontal run and so cannot exceed the raster

refusal-corpus.coverage: min-run boundary (>=), min-run too large -> count=0 ok, x-offset start, empty result, grey8-only refusal, and the four reachable A2/parameter image-error cases; byte-stability + fresh-store repeat asserted
